newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-MR MULLIGAN COMPLETES BIG RACE DOUBLE FOR MCCOY.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-MR MULLIGAN COMPLETES BIG RACE DOUBLE FOR MCCOY.

text.p: Mr Mulligan, a 20-1 chance, won the Cheltenham Gold Cup on Thursday to complete a golden double for jockey Tony McCoy.
He had captured the Champion Hurdle on Make A Stand on Tuesday.

Mr Mulligan, trained by Noel Chance, was never out of the first two and held on easily from 33-1 outsider Barton Bank, the mount of David Walsh, and Dorans Pride, a 10-1 shot, ridden by Shane Broderick.
Imperial Call, the favourite and last year's winner, had to be pulled up about five fences from home.
The Gold Cup was the highlight of the final day of the Cheltenham jump racing festival.
